_comment: Settings and known lists for the Web browser tests job (TC-2120). The job fails on any failure that is NOT a listed known red, on a skipped test that is not in knownSkipped, and on an incomplete report: no tests, fewer than minTests, a project in `projects` with none, a spec file with none, stats that disagree with the tests, or a nonzero Playwright exit status that known reds do not fully explain. minTests: raise it when specs are added (it is a floor that catches a spec file that stops loading; the suite had 164 tests when it was set). knownReds: a listed test that fails is printed as a known red; when it passes the job prints 'known red now passes: delete it from the list'. Entry format: { project, file, title (as in the report), line (informational), reason }. Add an entry only with a diagnosis, not as a skip, and delete it when the spec is fixed. A test that failed and passed on its retry is a flake: Playwright reports it and the job passes, so there is no list for it.
